summary: Rio Tinto filed a 6-K covering September 2026 announcements largely unrelated to a single special situation: total voting rights and issued capital (1,256,050,913 ordinary shares; 897,389 treasury shares; 1,255,153,524 voting rights as of 31 August 2026), share issues, dividend distribution notices and currency exchange rates for the 2026 interim dividend, an FCA-required prospectus publication, Aboriginal land agreements for the Ngarlawangga and Nyangumarta Warrarn areas, a RevoCast low-carbon aluminium supply partnership, and PDMR/director interest notices. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or campaign is disclosed; watch for prospectus follow-up and dividend timing.
